method.download: Individual source-page links to official videos.pexels.com HD renditions. Files below are original downloaded bytes.
method.editing: None. No cropping, trimming, transcoding, speed changes, frame interpolation, generated frames, duplicated frames, or audio changes.
method.timing: ffprobe packet/frame presentation timestamps and frame counts; decoded-frame MD5 hashes via ffmpeg. FPS determined from media, not filename or rounded web page.
method.visual_review: Contact sheets from real decoded source frames; slow and basketball reviewed at2second spacing, challenge every0.5seconds. Thumbnail sampling is for review only and is not an input or benchmark.

clips.label: Slow full-body squats

source.title: Woman Doing Squats
source.description: Senior woman exercising with elastic band for fitness indoors.
source.author: Anna Shvets

clips.source_duration_basis: Duration of original downloaded HD rendition; not rounded web-page duration.
clips.visual_observations: A single woman performs controlled squats facing three-quarter toward camera. Full head, hands and both feet stay in frame in inspected samples. A resistance band is visible above knees; her hands overlap during squats. Even indoor background.

clips.label: Basketball shot

source.title: Man Shooting a Basketball
source.description: Man shooting hoops on an outdoor basketball court.
source.author: olia danilevich

clips.source_duration_basis: Duration of original downloaded HD rendition; not rounded web-page duration.
clips.visual_observations: A single man performs a basketball shot, viewed from behind/slightly to the side. Full body remains visible; both hands and ball overlap near the upper torso and above the head. This is a moderately fast natural shot, not an extreme-motion or frontal test.

clips.label: Full-body turns and self-occlusion

source.title: Man Dancing On the Street
source.description: Energetic street dance performance by a young man in an urban setting.
source.author: RDNE Stock project

clips.source_duration_basis: Duration of original downloaded HD rendition; not rounded web-page duration.
clips.visual_observations: A single man street-dances with fast footwork, hops, repeated front/side/back turns and limb self-occlusion. Full body is visible in a dense contact sheet sampled every0.5seconds. Subject is smaller in frame than in the portrait clips; outdoor shadows and body yaw add difficulty.
